title: Add selectable queued PRD detail view in Main
specification:
# PRD: Add selectable queued PRD detail view in Main

Priority: medium

## Problem
Managers can see queued PRD cards in Main, but cannot select a queued PRD and inspect its full details there. This makes the queue hard to review before planning starts, even though queued PRD data is already present in the dashboard model.

## Goal
Let managers select queued PRDs from Main and view their details in a dedicated detail panel or modal without leaving the main status view.

## Requirements
- Add selection state for queued PRDs in the Main project/repo view.
- Render a queued PRD detail view showing at least title, id, status, problem/specification, requirements, acceptance criteria, verification, timestamps, and source chat metadata when available.
- Allow switching between multiple queued PRDs in order without losing the current selection unexpectedly.
- Show a clear empty state when no queued PRDs exist.
- Reuse existing queued PRD data from the dashboard/status payload where possible instead of introducing a separate fetch path.
- Keep the existing finished-PRD History interaction intact.

## Acceptance Criteria
- When one or more queued PRDs exist, Main shows a selectable list and a visible detail view for the selected queued PRD.
- Selecting a different queued PRD updates the detail panel to that PRD's information.
- If the selected queued PRD disappears from the queue, the UI falls back gracefully to another queued PRD or an empty state.
- Managers can inspect all currently queued PRDs from Main without navigating to History or raw state views.

## Verification
- Add/update client UI tests covering queued PRD selection and detail rendering in Main.
- Add/update dashboard/control-plane tests proving queued PRD fields required by the detail view are present.
- Run `npm run typecheck` and the focused unit tests for control-plane client/dashboard behavior.
